research_question: On a new disjoint MS MARCO train-query sample, can fixed-assignment query-conditioned score distillation improve a rank-64 RPQ16x8 residual sidecar over its storage-identical unsupervised initializer while remaining stable across folds and seeds?
scope: fresh-query method development only; no V12 qid reuse, old holdout reuse, independent confirmation, official MS MARCO score, ScaNN claim, SOTA claim, or production latency claim

parent_evidence.diagnosis: V12 reduced unsigned weighted reconstruction error but did not directly fit signed query-residual scores; only 35 queries changed Recall across all seeds and no changed query had a consistent nonzero direction across every seed

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: the preregistered signed score-distilled fixed-assignment codebook did or did not show stable out-of-fold advantage over unsupervised RPQ and storage-matched PCA16 on the frozen 1M restricted development task
forbidden_claims: official MS MARCO development or leaderboard performance
generalization beyond the frozen 1M restricted corpus

fresh_query_freeze.source_dataset: MS MARCO passage ranking v1 training queries and qrels
fresh_query_freeze.selection_rule: among train qids with text and at least one positive passage id in the exact frozen 1M doc-id array, exclude every historical 6,980 qid and every frozen V12 qid, sort by SHA256('rars_v13_fresh_train_selection_v1\0' || canonical_qid_utf8), and take the first 5,000
fresh_query_freeze.relevance_denominator: all positive qrels for that query whose passage id occurs in the frozen 1M corpus

method.basis: one deterministic uncentred PCA rank-64 basis fit only on residual rows reached by the four training folds
method.baseline: Faiss ProductQuantizer fit without labels on the same fold-training coefficients, seed, iterations, assignments, and payload
method.challenger: per-block per-centroid closed-form ridge regression of signed FP32 residual scores on projected training queries, with cutoff and positive weighting, a query-covariance anchor, and no post-update reassignment

pca16_comparator.basis: uncentred PCA fit on the same fold-training residual rows
pca16_comparator.scale_calibration: per-dimension maximum absolute training coefficient divided by 127

score_distillation.observation_candidates: all fixed Base Top-40 candidates from training-fold queries
score_distillation.unjudged_treatment: ordinary candidate with no non-relevant claim
score_distillation.anchor: for each centroid, anchor to its unsupervised value with ratio 1.0 times that centroid's observation mass under the block-average query covariance

rpq_training.implementation: Faiss ProductQuantizer on fixed PCA coefficients

prohibited_actions: reading a V9, V10, V11, or V12 result packet from the V13 freezer or trainer
using any historical 6,980 MS MARCO dev qid or any V12 qid
using the held-out fold to fit PCA, RPQ, PCA16 scales, score statistics, centroids, alpha, Top-B, or gates
changing the method, weights, anchor, drift radius, seed list, or thresholds after outcomes appear
selecting the best seed or fold
reassigning product codes after score-distilled centroid fitting
calling an unjudged candidate explicitly non-relevant
claiming official MS MARCO performance from the restricted 1M corpus
claiming production efficiency from the Python development evaluator
